performanceBeforeOptimizations.environment: Owned headless Chrome --disable-gpu; sink-inclusive emit/getImageData observational wrappers
performanceBeforeOptimizations.conclusion: Measured GDI sink and pixel-read times are below 0.4% of the two finite initialized 2-boat paints. Math and translated control-flow optimization are the primary candidates; GetPixel batching or bitmap-font changes are not justified by these samples.

readOnlyCandidates.candidate: Disable event retention in production DCs
readOnlyCandidates.reason: Every paint allocates ordered event arrays without a proof consumer; preserve state and sink calls while keeping tracing enabled by default for tests.

readOnlyCandidates.reason: The host recreates canvas and context each paint; reset DC state and pixels explicitly when reusing it.

performanceBeforeOptimizations.guard: GetPixel is order-sensitive and may observe prior drawing within the same frame. A cache must track intervening writes; no stale whole-frame pixel cache is proposed.
